locale.description:
The locale to use for the output.
Example values: 'en-US'|'en'|'en-AU', etc.

maxWaitForFcp.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a page content render, in ms. If no content is rendered within this limit, the run is aborted with an error.

maxWaitForLoad.description: Max time to wait for page to load

throttlingMethod.description: The method used to throttle the network

auditMode.description: Flag indicating the run should only audit.

gatherMode.description: Flag indicating the run should only gather

disableStorageReset.description: Flag indicating that the browser storage should not be reset for the audit.

blockedUrlPatterns.description: The network request patterns that Lighthouse blocked while loading the page.

onlyCategories.description:
Includes only the specified categories in the final report.
Additive with onlyAudits and reduces the time to audit a page.

onlyAudits.description:
Includes only the specified audits in the final report.
Additive with onlyCategories and reduces the time to audit a page.

skipAudits.description:
Excludes the specified audits from the final report.
Takes priority over onlyCategories, not usable in conjuction with onlyAudits, and reduces the time to audit a page.

channel.description:
How Lighthouse was run, e.g. from the Chrome extension or from the npm module.
Possible values: lr, node (default)

precomputedLanternData.description: Precomputed lantern estimates to use instead of observed analysis.

name: LighthouseConfigSettings
